DeterminationBasis: T01-001 establishes complete governing state and T01-003 rejects scope substitution, but neither directly requires the scope of the governing state itself to be explicitly represented. Explicit scope representation is therefore preserved as a separate test obligation.

T14-005 requires predecessor and successor states to remain identifiable and immutable within their declared states while preserving explicit correction-forward lineage. That directly prevents a frozen predecessor state from being modified to represent later conditions.
